title: 第13章 总统套get第14章 缺个3060Ti
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第13章总统套get（..）系统一定是在偷窥我的心声！
周望反应过来，瞬间就得出了这样的结论。
他刚刚还在思索怎么解决住的问题，转眼系统就给他提出了解决方案。
第二个行动回合的触发简直不要太及时，看完系统前面的说明之后，周望这才理解为什么核心奖励机制叫做“黄金屋”
“书中自有黄金屋是吧……好好好！”
“房产盲盒？刺激啊！”
等再看到后面系统的说明，周望顿时明白这也跟第一个行动回合类似，依旧会根据他最终的评分来决定奖励的力度。
也就是说，理论上他在这两个星期的时间内读的书越多，最后得到的房子也会越大。
而众所周知，在地段相等的情况下，房子大=房子贵。
最后系统赠送的那個“回合特权”
也是及时雨，不用花一分钱就能白嫖任意酒店，那就没什么好想的，当然是五星级酒店走起！
平复了一下惊喜的心，周望这才用意念点开了系统生成的书单。
看到那长长的一串列表，周望瞬间就知道自己这两个星期是不可能读完上面所有的书籍了。
粗略看了一下，周望确定这上面的书他一本都没有读过，其中不乏一些知名度很广的书籍，但都完全避开了周望已有的积累。
而书籍的类目系统都作出了标注，基本涵盖了周望能想到的所有类别。
有金融类，比如大名鼎鼎的《货币战争》、《国富论》，也有周望从来没听说过的，比如有一本书，他看名字完全想不到这跟金融有什么关系，书的名字叫做《黑天鹅》。
有社科人文，比如《全球通史》、《心理学与生活》，也有科学书籍，比如《数学之美》、《时间简史》等等。
还有像《三体》这样的科幻小说，像《活着》这样的现实主义文学，也有纯粹的古文，比如《山海经》、《金瓶梅》……呃，好像混入了什么奇怪的东西。
周望甚至还在繁杂的书单中，看到了和英语六级考试相关的辅导书。
看不完，根本看不完。

周望原本还想着14天的时间也太久了，看到这书单才知道系统已经对他够厚道了。
至少没有让他全部看一遍再奖励他房子。
而每一本书籍后面都标注了高低不等的积分，系统还给出了自己打分的依据，是结合了阅读时长、阅读难度、消化难度等多方面因素判定。
周望目前看到的积分值最高的是华夏的《周易》，也就是唯一没有失传的那部分《易经》，只要读完直接给1000积分！
也就等于一套一千平的房子直接到手……
但周望知道没有那么简单。
打开手机搜索了一下，《周易》全文才5000个字，以周望看网络小说的速度，顶天了10分钟就扫完了。
但“看”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Wealth Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 13 The President’s Get (..) System must be peeking into my heart!
Zhou Wang reacted and came to this conclusion instantly.
Just now, he was thinking about how to solve the housing problem, but in the blink of an eye, the system came up with a solution for him.
The triggering of the second action round cannot be too timely. After reading the previous description of the system, Zhou Wang finally understood why the core reward mechanism is called "Golden House"
"There is a golden house in the book, right... OK, OK!"
"Real estate blind box? Exciting!"
When he saw the explanation of the system later, Zhou Wang immediately understood that this was similar to the first action round, and the intensity of the reward would still be determined based on his final score.
In other words, in theory, the more books he reads during these two weeks, the bigger the house he will get in the end.
As we all know, when the location is equal, a bigger house = a more expensive house.
The “round privilege” given by the system at the end
It's also timely. You can get into any hotel for free without spending a penny, so there's nothing to think about. Of course, it's a five-star hotel!
After calming down his surprise, Zhou Wang opened the book list generated by the system with his mind.
Seeing the long list, Zhou Wang instantly knew that he would not be able to read all the books on it in the past two weeks.
After a cursory glance, Zhou Wang determined that he had not read any of the books on it. There were some well-known books among them, but they completely avoided Zhou Wang's existing accumulation.
The category system of books has been marked, covering basically all categories that Zhou Wang can think of.
There are financial ones, such as the famous "Currency War" and "The Wealth of Nations", and there are also books that Zhou Wang has never heard of, such as a book whose name he never imagined had anything to do with finance. The name of the book is "Black Swan".
There are social sciences and humanities, such as "General History of the World" and "Psychology and Life", as well as scientific books, such as "The Beauty of Mathematics", "A Brief History of Time" and so on.
There are also science fiction novels like "The Three-Body Problem", realist literature like "To Live", and pure ancient texts, such as "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" and "The Plum in the Golden Lotus"... Well, it seems like something strange has been mixed in.
Zhou Wang even saw tutorial books related to the CET-6 exam in the complicated book list.
I can’t finish it, I can’t finish it at all.
Zhou Wang originally thought that 14 days was too long, but when he saw this book list, he realized that the system had been kind enough to him.
At least I didn't make him read them all before rewarding him with a house.
Each book is marked with points ranging from high to low, and the system also provides its own basis for scoring, which is based on factors such as reading time, reading difficulty, and digestion difficulty.
The one with the highest points value that Zhou Wang has seen so far is China's "Book of Changes", which is the only part of the "Book of Changes" that has not been lost. As long as you finish reading it, you will be given 1,000 points!
This is equivalent to directly acquiring a house of 1,000 square meters...
But Zhou Wang knew it wasn't that simple.
I turned on my phone and searched for it. I found that the full text of "The Book of Changes" is only 5,000 words long. At Zhou Wang's speed of reading online novels, I finished it in 10 minutes.
But "see"
